scoring_justification: Headline band edge positions cannot be recomputed from raw artifacts without full DFT rerun; compare reported final values to paper reference within tolerance, plus internal consistency check.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold E_C_edge - A_edge values for the six materials from the paper's Table V.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the published paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The values are the paper's own reported results and are verified against the reference solve.sh output.

material.description: Semiconductor name (e.g., TiO2, WO3, CdS, ZnSe, GaAs, GaP).

E_C_bulk_minus_H_semi_bulk.description: CBM eigenvalue relative to average Hartree potential in the bulk semiconductor.

A_bulk_minus_H_sol_bulk.description: Water acceptor level (H3O+ LUMO) relative to average Hartree potential in bulk liquid water.

H_semi_edge_minus_H_sol_edge.description: Difference in average Hartree potentials between the semiconductor side and the water side at the interface.

E_C_edge_minus_A_edge.description: CBM band edge position relative to the H2O/H2 level; equals (E_C_bulk_minus_H_semi_bulk) - (A_bulk_minus_H_sol_bulk) + (H_semi_edge_minus_H_sol_edge).

outputs.description: Computed CBM band edge positions relative to water H2O/H2 level for six photocatalyst semiconductors.

output_contract.notes: The checker will verify that for each material the reported E_C_edge_minus_A_edge equals the algebraic combination of the three component fields (within a small numerical tolerance) and will then compare each final value to a hidden reference with an absolute tolerance of 0.2 eV. All six materials must be present.
